what: Lam Research builds the machines chipmakers use to etch away and deposit thin layers of material on silicon wafers, steps that are repeated hundreds of times in memory and logic chips.
customers: A handful of large chipmakers: TSMC, Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, Intel and Chinese fabs.
money: spare parts, service and upgrades for installed machines
moat: Leadership in etch, especially for memory, deep process know-how and a large installed base that needs service.
